error_reason: The Planner incorrectly assumed and repeatedly asserted specific birth years (Teja: 1966, Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen: 1971) without verifying that the actual Wikipedia pages contained this data. The WebSurfer agent consistently returned search results showing only the 'Upgrade to our browser' advertisement at the top of the page, indicating the agent failed to scroll or parse the actual content of the Wikipedia articles. Consequently, the Planner based its entire conclusion on hallucinated facts rather than the actual retrieved information, leading to a false determination.

suggested_fix.fix_text: Before asserting specific birth years from search results, explicitly verify if the top of the rendered Wikipedia page contains the birth date. If the viewport does not show the birth date, scroll down or request the next visible section of the page to confirm the data.

probe_details.notes: The proposed error analysis is correct in identifying that the WebSurfer agent failed to read the actual content of the Wikipedia pages (indicated by the 'Upgrade to our browser' ad at the top of the viewport), leading to hallucinated birth years (Teja 1966, Imasuen 1971). In reality, Teja (director of Nene Raju Nene Mantri) was born in 1966, and Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen (director of Invasion 1897) was born in 1960. While the Planner eventually concluded Teja was born earlier, this was based on hallucinated data because Imasuen was actually born earlier (1960 vs 1966). The core failure described—the inability to parse the web content due to ad blockers or viewport issues—is accurate. The analysis correctly attributes the error to the agent not scrolling/verifying.
